rule: Write like a quality manager to another quality manager
example: Assessors check FMS.2.c CORE compliance first

rule: Use specific numbers always
example: 302 OEs in ECO Full not hundreds of OEs

rule: Reference chapter codes naturally
example: The AAC chapter covers patient access and assessment

rule: First-person founder voice for blog articles
example: In my 15 years of hospital operations I have seen...

rule: Never use the word comprehensive
example: comprehensive solution -> use specific instead

rule: Never use the word robust
example: robust system -> say what it actually does

rule: Never use the word seamlessly
example: seamlessly integrates -> just say how it works

rule: Never use leverage as a verb
example: leverage our platform -> use AccredReady

rule: Never use revolutionize or transform healthcare
example: sounds fake in B2B healthcare context

rule: Never use world-class or best-in-class
example: unverifiable claim — kills credibility

rule: We are the NABH-native tool not an HMS
example: AccredReady is built only for NABH compliance — not an HMS

rule: Do not bash competitors by name
example: Never mention MocDoc Adrine Unidoc by name

rule: Position against the problem not other products
example: Most hospitals prepare for NABH using Excel and consultants

rule: Never write 639 OEs in public copy
example: Say multiple NABH programmes or list them by name

rule: NABH content from nabh.co or official PDF only
example: Never generate NABH facts from general knowledge

rule: No fake urgency or artificial scarcity
example: Limited time offer -> Remove completely

rule: Always include edition and year for NABH content
example: HCO 6th Edition 2024 not just HCO standards

rule: Dr. Khanna byline only with his explicit approval
example: Never publish under his name without confirmation

rule: Hiral case studies must anonymise hospital names
example: Unless explicit written consent given

rule: One CTA per page — never multiple competing CTAs
example: End with: Start free on AccredReady -> accredready.in

rule: CTA language: low commitment free trial framing
example: Try AccredReady free not Buy now or Subscribe

rule: Always show INR pricing when mentioned
example: ₹499/month not $6/month

rule: Write for busy quality managers not administrators
example: Assume reader knows NABH exists and has done at least one audit

rule: Secondary audience: NABH consultants
example: Mention consultant use case: manage multiple hospitals

rule: Soni Ahlawat is personal friend with comped account — never treat as lead
example: Never include in outreach campaigns

rule: Author byline must say "Healthcare Operations Leader" not "NABH-certified Quality Manager"
example: Dr. Mehul Upadhyay | Healthcare Operations Leader | Medical Services HMP Foundation
